from pyscf import gto, scf, dft, mcscf, tdscf

mol = gto.Mole()
mol.atom = '''
O   0.00504184  0.39778311  0.00000000
H  -0.76592744 -0.18921547  0.00000000
H   0.76088559 -0.20856764  0.00000000
'''
mol.basis = 'sto-3g'
mol.charge = 0
mol.spin = 0  # 2S = n_alpha - n_beta
mol.build()

mf = dft.RKS(mol) if mol.spin == 0 else dft.ROKS(mol)
mf.xc = 'b3lyp'
mf.kernel()
hess = mf.Hessian().kernel()
from pyscf.hessian import thermo
freq_info = thermo.harmonic_analysis(mol, hess)
thermo_info = thermo.thermo(mf, freq_info['freq_au'], 298.15)
